description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Meddegoda, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District (25/0358)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including ownership details, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land Gazettes" as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific land parcels in designated locations.
